title: Omit features that have no faithful Linux equivalent
context: Four upstream features depend on Windows-only platform capabilities. Implementing look-alikes would produce behaviour the platform cannot support and would misrepresent the result.
options: Implement approximations (fake queue data, a Shell extension, a global hook workaround)
Omit them and document the platform limitation
Ship them disabled behind a hidden flag
proposal: Omit Next-Up, the taskbar widget/visualizer, acrylic backdrop blur and the global media-key hook; document each limitation in README and docs/rea-report.md.
decision: Omit and document. The remaining features are complete and verified rather than diluted by non-functional imitations.
consequences: The port is smaller than the upstream feature list.
Each omission is traceable to a platform constraint, with the nearest supported behaviour described.
